findings.summary: HEADS prior-pointer validation accepts a valid record under the wrong paper key.
findings.reproduction: Synthetic workspace published paper A, forged HEADS {paper B: record A}, then imported paper B. import_knowledge returned ok=True and replaced the forged pointer; expected LIGHT_KNOWLEDGE_CONFLICT with bytes preserved.

findings.summary: A structurally valid view bundle copied from another workspace is accepted as the prior CURRENT referent.
findings.reproduction: Synthetic workspace copied a valid view bundle and CURRENT pointer from workspace A into workspace B without its records. build_knowledge_views returned ok=True and replaced CURRENT; expected foreign-reference conflict with bytes preserved.

findings.summary: Record bundle integrity does not bind manifest/identity paper_snapshot to identity.wrapper.paper_snapshot.
findings.reproduction: After a synthetic source metadata title edit, updated manifest source/paper_snapshot and identity paper_snapshot plus the declared identity hash, while retaining the old wrapper snapshot. list_knowledge classified the record current; expected conflict.

findings.summary: Comparison inline citation labels do not escape title newlines as table-cell content.
findings.reproduction: Synthetic source metadata title containing a literal newline produced a citation row split at the title newline (label uses escape_md in _inline_citation_link). Expected one safe table cell and linked citation.
findings.likely_scope: light_compare.py _inline_citation_link should use table-cell-safe escaping before trusted link composition
